title: Von Braun oversaw slave labor camp

tellings.quote: Yeah, Wernher Von Braun oversaw a brutal, mostly Jewish slave labor camp where tons and tons of people died.

plain: Michels says that the German rocket engineer Wernher von Braun oversaw "a brutal, mostly Jewish slave labor camp where tons and tons of people died" in Germany in the 1940s. He says it himself, in passing, during a conversation about hidden government UFO programmes, without naming a source. If true, it would cast a dark light on one of the men who shaped rocketry and space flight.
